literal_en: A white beard and the flour bad.
meaning_en: i.e. an old man like you to behave so badly.

source.book: Grammar and Dictionary of Western Panjabi, as spoken in the Shahpur District, with Proverbs, Sayings and Verses

meaning_pa: چٹی داہڑی تے آٹا خراب؛ یعنی تیرے جیہا بڈھا بندہ تے ایہو جہی بھیڑی کرتوت!
